Platform: Email header banner
Required canvas: 1600 x 600 px
Required aspect ratio: 8:3 wide horizontal
Old conflicting platform to ignore: Clinic poster 4:5 vertical.
Top safe zone: 52 px.
Bottom safe zone: 64 px.
Side safe margin: 96 px.
Logo: top-right inside email header safe zone.
CTA: center-right portal button with phone line below.
Text density: no more than 6 short text blocks; headline should be largest and at most 2 lines.
Hero: must stay readable without covering CTA, disclosure, or source line.
